items.prompt: Why can this correct close-and-drain normal path still be unsuitable for a production event pipeline?
items.modelAnswer: No overall deadlines/fairness guarantee, worker-failure/cancellation propagation, durable storage/replay/reconciliation or end-to-end memory/admission policy. Ordinary condition_variable is not automatically stop-token-aware. Need observed wait/age/occupancy and accepted/rejected counts, safe lifetime and coordinated failure tests.

criteria.text: Separates local queue safety from progress/durability.
Keeps item bound distinct from end-to-end resource bound.
